description: CICE4.0 is a comprehensive sea ice model that simulates both thermodynamic and dynamic processes, including ice advection and mechanical redistribution, using an ice-thickness distribution to capture subgrid-scale variability. Its physics are driven by an elastic-viscous-plastic (EVP) rheology for ice dynamics and advanced thermodynamics with shortwave radiation schemes like Delta-Eddington to improve albedo and melt estimates. A notable feature of this version is its flexible coupling design, allowing easy integration with different ocean and atmosphere models to enhance polar climate simulations.
